decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records that public prize-pool statistics use only the replacement contract's new pool state and exclude the old contract.
A same-message MODIFY already fully applies the accepted fresh-contract policy to dashboard ownership, limiting it to successfully minted replacement-contract NFTs and excluding old-contract NFTs.
A same-message MODIFY already fully records that visible tickets belong to replacement-contract NFTs and new draw cycles, with old-contract ticket state excluded.
A same-message MODIFY already captures both necessary effects: replacement-contract-only mint statistics and NFT numbering restarted at #1.
A same-message MODIFY already limits displayed referral counts to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes referral records associated with the unused old contract.
A same-message MODIFY already applies the accepted replacement-contract-only system policy to active commission and earnings displays.
A same-message MODIFY already fully records that public referral statistics use replacement-contract referral data and exclude old-contract referrals.
Starting fresh on the replacement contract does not change the required metadata fields or their meaning for newly minted NFTs.
The contract migration and draw-cycle reset do not alter the requirement to render NFT covers and wallet images correctly.
The existing FAQ mechanics remain valid for the replacement contract, and the source does not require public copy about legacy-contract exclusion or numbering migration.
The accepted migration decision is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE, including fresh state, numbering from #1, legacy-contract exclusion, and no copy migration.
The About-page descriptions of mint numbering, referrals, and prize draws remain valid for the replacement contract; the source does not require migration-specific copy.
